entities.summary: Ivan Kasutin is a Russian professional ice hockey goaltender who currently plays for Metallurg Novokuznetsk in the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). He has previously played as a journeyman with nine clubs within the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
